finite_frontier_theorem.name: V0_5_PROOF_SELECTOR_NO_RAW_CAP_RESCUE_REQUIRED_THROUGH_N50
finite_frontier_theorem.statement: Inherit N<=49. At N=50, m<=6 is invariant and L<3r roots reroot into the previous frontier. The remaining hard region has r<=10. r<=8 is closed by the existing recurrence; r=9 degree-3 roots enter the s<=45,n<=8 tail below cap 2500. For r=10, m=7 enters m<=6; m=8 is closed by the same bounded bridge; and the sole new m=9,L=30 case has all degrees exactly three. Its selected degree-3 ordinary elimination gives m1<=8,s1<=45,n1<=9. If n1<=8 recurrence closes; if n1=9, average incidence forces the next selected degree <=4, after which fixed finite size/clause bounds reach n<=6 and Uraw(6)=1053 closes the tail. No false m<=7 invariant is assumed.
